verdict.rationale: Grok is itself the built-in AI assistant, and the docs show real delegation: Grok Bot hands work to AI teammates on a persistent cloud computer, and connectors let Grok take actions such as creating Salesforce records and sending Teams messages from chat. Community users report delegating coding and legal tasks with good results, though one hands-on report notes earlier Grok 4 struggled with agentic tool calling. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the Grok Bot delegation workflow, consistent independent corroboration of reliable agentic tool execution.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Grok Bot — hand real work to AI teammates on a persistent cloud computer.
Create new records - Add Leads, Opportunities, Accounts, Cases, or records on custom objects directly from chat.
Search across channels and chats, read messages, send new messages, reply to threads, and create chats — all without leaving Grok.
Connect your tools so Grok can reach your email, files, and calendar right inside a chat.
